name: obilet/bus-window-seat
description: Find a night bus on Obilet from one city to another on a given date, choose a window seat confirmed on the seat map, and stop at the passenger/payment form.
source_task: Open Obilet. Find Ankara → Fethiye buses departing on 29 September 2026 at night. Verify a window seat from the seat map. Stop when personal  details or payment information are required. Enable full logging.
note: hidden: it got stuck on its first run and no fix was saved

steps.goal: Search Obilet for BUS trips (otobüs, not flights) from {origin} to {destination} with departure date {date}. Set the origin to {origin}, the destination to {destination} and the date to {date} in the search form, then run the search. Stop when the list of bus trips for {origin} → {destination} on {date} is shown. Do not pick a trip yet.

On the results page, confirm that the listed trips are {origin} → {destination} and dated {date}. Find a trip whose departure time on the page is at night ({night_window}) on {date}. Open that trip's seat map. If no trip departing {night_window} on {date} is listed, do not open any trip and do not reach the completion state.

On the open seat map, select exactly ONE free seat that the seat map itself shows as a WINDOW seat. Use the map's legend, a window/cam kenarı label, or the seat's tooltip, or its position in the outermost column next to the bus wall. A seat number alone is NOT proof. Do not pick taken or blocked seats. If no seat can be proven to be a window seat from the page, do not select any seat and do not reach the completion state. After selecting, confirm the page shows this seat as selected.

With the proven window seat selected on the night trip {origin} → {destination} on {date}, press the site's continue/confirm button to move to the next step. Stop as soon as a form asking for passenger personal details (name, ID number, phone, e-mail) or payment information appears. Do not type anything into that form and do not pay.
